changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0034. Add package category and calendar duration to membership plans, and store freeze periods without rewriting membership history. Index review: UX_MembershipPlans_TenantId_Name and IX_MembershipPlans_TenantId already serve plan lists; IX_GymMemberships_TenantId_Status_EndDate and IX_GymMemberships_MemberProfileId already serve membership lists and member history. UX_MembershipFreezes_Open enforces one open freeze per membership. IX_MembershipFreezes_GymMembershipId reads a membership's freeze history. Performance note: freeze lookups seek one membership, and plan lists stay tenant-scoped.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE app.MembershipPlans ADD PackageCategory NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_MembershipPlans_PackageCategory DEFAULT N'Standard', DurationUnit NVARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_MembershipPlans_DurationUnit DEFAULT N'Day', DurationCount INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_MembershipPlans_DurationCount DEFAULT 1;

UPDATE app.MembershipPlans SET DurationCount = CASE MembershipType WHEN N'Monthly' THEN 1 WHEN N'Quarterly' THEN 3 WHEN N'HalfYearly' THEN 6 WHEN N'Yearly' THEN 12 ELSE DurationDays END, DurationUnit = CASE WHEN MembershipType = N'Custom' THEN N'Day' ELSE N'Month' END;
ALTER TABLE app.MembershipPlans ADD CONSTRAINT CK_MembershipPlans_PackageCategory CHECK (PackageCategory IN (N'Standard', N'Student', N'Women', N'Corporate', N'Couple'));
ALTER TABLE app.MembershipPlans ADD CONSTRAINT CK_MembershipPlans_DurationUnit CHECK (DurationUnit IN (N'Day', N'Month'));
ALTER TABLE app.MembershipPlans ADD CONSTRAINT CK_MembershipPlans_DurationCount CHECK (DurationCount > 0);

CREATE TABLE app.MembershipFreezes ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, GymMembershipId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, StartDate DATE NOT NULL, EndDate DATE NULL, Reason NVARCHAR(500) NULL, PreviousStatus NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_MembershipFreezes PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_MembershipFreezes_Tenants FOREIGN KEY (TenantId) REFERENCES app.Tenants (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_MembershipFreezes_GymMemberships FOREIGN KEY (GymMembershipId) REFERENCES app.GymMemberships (Id), CONSTRAINT CK_MembershipFreezes_Dates CHECK (EndDate IS NULL OR EndDate >= StartDate) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_MembershipFreezes_Open ON app.MembershipFreezes (GymMembershipId) WHERE EndDate IS NULL; CREATE INDEX IX_MembershipFreezes_GymMembershipId ON app.MembershipFreezes (GymMembershipId, StartDate);
